message.content: All key figures verified. Now placing a single limit buy order sized within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
Trusted figures confirm: revenue 391,035; net income 93,736; EPS diluted 6.08; operating income 123,216; OCF 118,254.

Note: the "Highlights" line in the filing said $96,995M net income, and the income statement row repeated 96,995 for both 2024 and 2023 — that's an OCR/typo artifact. The trusted figure is 93,736, consistent with the cash flow statement and the equity statement. Good — I should note this discrepancy in my summary to be transparent.

Decision: Buy AAPL. Fundamentals: revenue +2% to $391B, services +13% to $96.2B at 73.9% gross margin, total gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%), operating income $123.2B, OCF $118.3B, cash+securities $140.8B. Risks: Greater China -8%, $10.2B one-time EU tax charge depressing 2024 EPS, DOJ/EU antitrust.

Position sizing: price ~$222.70. $10,000 max per order → floor(10000/222.72) ≈ 44 shares. 40 shares × 222.70 = $8,908. Limit price: close to market, say $223.00 (slightly above ask to be fillable) — that's within 0.13% of market. Actually "limit prices must be close to current market price" — $223.00 is 0.13% above. Good. Cost = 40 × 223 = $8,920 max ≤ 10,000. Total today ≤ 20,000. ✓ Cash $50,000 so no need to sell anything.

Let me place the order with key_figures.
